had been written months in advance by the most cunning mind in the city, and the mastermind of this chilling game was none other than Raghav, a man who once used to be the city's most brilliant software engineer and financial analyst whose designed security systems were praised by major banks, but the roll of fortune turned in such a way that his company framed him in a fake scam and sent him behind the bars of prison, and when he came out after being released, all his trust in society and law had transformed into the fire of hatred and revenge, and to take revenge for his destruction he took up the task of breaching the very security system of the bank that he had once strengthened himself, and for this, he meticulously studied every corner of the bank, the shift-changing time of the guards, the circuit boards of the alarms, and the response time of the police for months, and to execute this plan he chose some of the most cunning and notorious criminals of the city including Vikram, who was an arms dealer and former soldier, Kabir, who was an elite hacker, and Simran, who could hypnotize anyone with her beauty and cunning tricks, and these four together started rehearsing this bloody and well-planned heist in a secret warehouse where every single second was accounted for because Raghav knew that there was no room for error in this game and even a slight lapse could push them straight into the darkness of death or life imprisonment, and as per the plan on the day of the heist when the city's traffic was at its peak and most of the police patrols were busy towards Vienna Chowk, Raghav and his gang entered inside the bank just like ordinary customers and no one had the slightest inkling of their intentions, and Kabir cleverly entered the bank's main server room and digitally set the CCTV cameras on a loop so that the same old and normal pictures kept playing on the screen while the real game inside had already begun, exactly at two o'clock in the afternoon when the bank manager's cabin was a bit quiet, Vikram suddenly pulled out a terrifying automatic gun from his jacket and fired a shot in the air which caused screams to echo throughout the bank, making people lie down on the floor out of fear while the guards did not even get a chance to recover because Simran showed agility, snatched the gun from the guard in a single stroke, and knocked him unconscious, and Raghav, putting on a black mask on his face, threw a heavy bag onto the manager's table and ordered him to enter the vault password immediately, and the manager started typing the password with trembling hands while Raghav's cold and calm gaze was fixed on him, telling the manager without wasting a single moment that time was very short and if even a single minute more passed, no one's breath would be left here, so the manager nervously opened the heavy vault door inside of which bundles of currency notes and diamonds worth crores were shining, and Kabir and Vikram quickly started filling the bags with notes, collecting crores in cash within about five minutes, but just like every big conspiracy faces some hurdle or the other, a police patrol vehicle passing outside the bank sensed some suspicious activity and surrounded the bank from all sides while sounding sirens, and outside police cars had stopped with loudspeakers warning the criminals hiding inside the bank to surrender or else they would be shot dead, spreading panic among the customers inside and showing the first signs of anxiety on the gang members' faces, but Raghav had a strange silent smile on his face because he had prepared a plan to deal with this situation as well, so he immediately turned towards the rear exit door of the bank where an ambulance was already parked which they had managed to get inside through a fake hospital pass, and Raghav ordered his companions not to panic and board that ambulance from the rear part of the bank, and as soon as the police broke the glass of the main door and entered inside, Raghav and his gang sat in that ambulance through the back door and vanished into the crowded streets of the city, leaving the police officers who reached inside the bank with nothing but scattered papers, terrified people shivering with fear, and an open vault door, resulting in a citywide lockdown where every highway and border was sealed, the police commissioner made the case a matter of his prestige, and intelligence agencies were deployed at every nook and corner of the city, but for days the police searched far and wide for Raghav and his gang without finding a single clue because Raghav had not used any vehicle to transport the looted money out of the city, but instead used courier parcels that were routinely sent securely to other states, and even after weeks of investigation when the police got nothing, this case became the biggest and most unsolved mystery in the city's history, while far away from the city in a quiet hilly area inside a luxurious bungalow, Raghav was smiling looking at the bundles of his share of the money, feeling the coolness of the fire of revenge that he had ignited after his ruin, although the police are still wandering door-to-door searching for that mastermind, and that cunning mind is still preparing his next move far beyond the reach of the law because he knows that this game is not over yet, but rather this was just the beginning of that long and silent war which he waged against this corrupt system.
content_hi: शहर की चिलचिलाती धूप और व्यस्त सड़कों के बीचों-बीच स्थित बैंक ऑफ ओरिएंट की मुख्य शाखा एक सामान्य मंगलवार की तरह ही खुली थी जहाँ कैशियर अपनी खिड़कियों पर व्यस्त थे, गार्ड अपनी कुर्सी पर ऊंघ रहा था और ग्राहक अपने लेन-देन में मशगूल थे लेकिन किसी को यह आभास नहीं था कि कुछ ही पलों में इस शांत माहौल को एक ऐसी खौफनाक साजिश का सामना करना पड़ेगा जिसकी पटकथा महीनों पहले शहर के सबसे शातिर दिमाग द्वारा लिखी जा चुकी थी और इस खौफनाक खेल का मास्टरमाइंड कोई और नहीं बल्कि राघव था, एक ऐसा शख्स जो कभी शहर का सबसे होनहार सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियर और वित्तीय विश्लेषक हुआ करता था जिसकी बनाई गई सुरक्षा प्रणालियों की तारीफ बड़े-बड़े बैंक किया करते थे लेकिन किस्मत के पासे ने ऐसी पलटी खाई कि उसकी कंपनी ने उसे एक फर्जी घोटाले में फंसाकर जेल की सलाखों के पीछे भेज दिया और जब वह छूटकर बाहर आया तो समाज और कानून के प्रति उसका सारा भरोसा नफरत और इंतकाम की आग में बदल चुका था, उसने अपनी तबाही का बदला लेने के लिए बैंक की उसी सुरक्षा व्यवस्था को भेदने का बीड़ा उठाया जिसे उसने कभी खुद मजबूत किया था और इसके लिए उसने महीनों तक बैंक के हर एक कोने, गार्ड्स की शिफ्ट बदलने के समय, अलार्म के सर्किट बोर्ड और पुलिस के रिस्पांस टाइम का बारीकी से अध्ययन किया था, उसने अपनी इस योजना को अमलीजामा पहनाने के लिए शहर के कुछ सबसे शातिर और कुख्यात अपराधियों को चुना जिनमें से एक का नाम विक्रम था जो हथियारों का सौदागर और पूर्व फौजी था, दूसरा कबीर था जो एक बेहतरीन हैकर था और तीसरा सिमरन थी जो अपनी खूबसूरती और शातिर चालों से किसी को भी सम्मोहित कर सकती थी, इन चारों ने मिलकर एक गुप्त गोदाम में अपनी इस खूनी और सुनियोजित डकैती की रिहर्सल शुरू की जहाँ हर एक सेकंड का हिसाब रखा गया था क्योंकि राघव जानता था कि इस खेल में गलती की कोई गुंजाइश नहीं है और थोड़ी सी भी चूक उन्हें सीधे मौत या उम्रकैद के अंधेरे में धकेल सकती थी, योजना के तहत डकैती के दिन जब शहर का ट्रैफिक अपनी चरम सीमा पर था और पुलिस की अधिकांश गश्त वियना चौक की तरफ व्यस्त थी, राघव और उसका गिरोह बिल्कुल आम ग्राहकों की तरह बैंक के अंदर दाखिल हुआ और किसी को भी उनके इरादों की भनक तक नहीं लगी, कबीर ने बेहद चालाकी से बैंक के मेन सर्वर रूम में घुसकर डिजिटल रूप से सीसीटीवी कैमरों को एक लूप पर सेट कर दिया जिससे स्क्रीन पर वही पुरानी और सामान्य तस्वीरें चलती रहीं जबकि अंदर का असली खेल शुरू हो चुका था, ठीक दोपहर के दो बजे जब बैंक के मैनेजर का केबिन थोड़ा शांत था, विक्रम ने अचानक अपनी जैकेट से एक खौफनाक ऑटोमैटिक गन निकाली और हवा में एक फायर झोंक दिया जिससे पूरे बैंक में चीख-पुकार मच गई, लोग डर के मारे जमीन पर लेट गए और गार्ड्स को संभलने का मौका तक नहीं मिला क्योंकि सिमरन ने फुर्ती दिखाते हुए एक ही झटके में गार्ड की बंदूक छीन ली और उसे बेहोश कर दिया, राघव ने अपने चेहरे पर काले रंग का नकाब चढ़ाते हुए मैनेजर की टेबल पर एक भारी भरकम बैग फेंका और उसे तुरंत तिजोरी का पासवर्ड डालने का आदेश दिया, मैनेजर कांपते हाथों से पासवर्ड डालने लगा लेकिन राघव की ठंडी और शांत नजरें उस पर टिकी थीं, उसने बिना एक पल गंवाए मैनेजर से कहा कि वक्त बहुत कम है और अगर एक मिनट भी ज्यादा लगा तो यहां किसी की सांसें नहीं बचेंगी, मैनेजर ने घबराकर तिजोरी का भारी दरवाजा खोल दिया जिसके अंदर नोटों के बंडल और करोड़ों की कीमत के हीरे-जवाहरात चमक रहे थे, कबीर और विक्रम ने तेजी से नोटों के बैग भरने शुरू कर दिए और लगभग पांच मिनट के भीतर ही वे करोड़ों की नकदी समेट चुके थे, लेकिन जैसा कि हर बड़ी साजिश में कोई न कोई अड़चन जरूर आती है, बैंक के बाहर से गुजर रही एक पुलिस गश्त गाड़ी को किसी संदिग्ध गतिविधि का अहसास हो गया और उन्होंने सायरन बजाते हुए बैंक को चारों तरफ से घेर लिया, बाहर पुलिस की गाड़ियां रुक चुकी थीं और लाउडस्पीकर पर चेतावनी दी जा रही थी कि बैंक के अंदर छिपे अपराधी आत्मसमर्पण कर दें वरना उन्हें गोली मार दी जाएगी, बैंक के अंदर मौजूद ग्राहकों में दहशत फैल गई और गैंग के सदस्यों के चेहरों पर पहली बार शिकन दिखाई दी लेकिन राघव के चेहरे पर एक अजीब सी खामोश मुस्कान थी क्योंकि उसने इस स्थिति से निपटने के लिए भी एक प्लान तैयार किया था, उसने तुरंत बैंक के पिछले निकास द्वार का रुख किया जहाँ एक एम्बुलेंस पहले से ही खड़ी थी जिसे उन्होंने एक अस्पताल के फर्जी पास के जरिए अंदर तक मंगवा लिया था, राघव ने अपने साथियों को आदेश दिया कि वे घबराएं नहीं और बैंक के पिछले हिस्से से उस एम्बुलेंस में सवार हो जाएं, जैसे ही पुलिस ने मुख्य दरवाजे का कांच तोड़कर अंदर प्रवेश किया, राघव और उसका गिरोह पिछले दरवाजे से उस एम्बुलेंस में बैठकर शहर की भीड़भाड़ भरी गलियों में ओझल हो चुका था, पुलिस वाले जब तक बैंक के अंदर पहुंचे तब तक वहां सिर्फ बिखरे हुए कागज, खौफ से कांपते हुए लोग और एक खुला हुआ तिजोरी का दरवाजा मिला, शहर भर में नाकाबंदी कर दी गई, हर हाईवे और बॉर्डर को सील कर दिया गया, पुलिस कमिश्नर ने इस मामले को अपनी प्रतिष्ठा का प्रश्न बना लिया और शहर के चप्पे-चप्पे पर खुफिया एजेंसियों को तैनात कर दिया गया, कई दिनों तक पुलिस राघव और उसके गिरोह की तलाश में खाक छानती रही लेकिन उनका कोई सुराग नहीं मिला क्योंकि राघव ने डकैती की रकम को शहर से बाहर ले जाने के लिए किसी गाड़ी का नहीं बल्कि कूरियर के उन पार्सलों का इस्तेमाल किया था जो रोजाना सुरक्षित तरीके से दूसरे राज्यों में भेजे जाते थे, हफ्तों की छानबीन के बाद भी जब पुलिस के हाथ कुछ नहीं लगा तो यह मामला शहर के इतिहास की सबसे बड़ी और अनसुलझी पहेली बन गया, उधर शहर से कोसों दूर एक शांत पहाड़ी इलाके में एक आलीशान बंगले के अंदर राघव अपने हिस्से की रकम के बंडलों को देखकर मुस्कुरा रहा था, उसकी आंखों में उस बदले की आग की ठंडक थी जो उसने अपनी बर्बादी के बाद जलाई थी, हालांकि पुलिस आज भी उस मास्टरमाइंड की तलाश में दर-दर भटक रही है और वह शातिर दिमाग आज भी कानून की नजरों से कोसों दूर अपनी अगली चाल की तैयारी कर रहा है क्योंकि वह जानता है कि यह खेल अभी खत्म नहीं हुआ है बल्कि यह तो बस उस लंबी और खामोश जंग की एक शुरुआत थी जो उसने इस भ्रष्ट व्यवस्था के खिलाफ छेड़ी थी।

content_en: As soon as the police stepped inside the old and desolate-looking mansion numbered forty-two in the posh area of the city, a heavy silence and a pungent smell of blood began to float in the air, making the heart of every constable present there shudder, and the path from the main entrance all the way inside told a tale of terrible devastation, because as soon as Inspector Vikram Singh flashed his torchlight toward that inner room, his eyes remained wide open and a slight scream escaped his mouth which he immediately suppressed because that room had transformed into a condition worse than a slaughterhouse, and every single corner of that room was draped in a terrifying sheet of crimson color, seeing which it could be clearly guessed how ruthlessly and agonizingly death had danced its savage dance there, right in the middle of that blood-soaked room stood an old wide bed upon which the spread white sheet had now completely turned into deep, thick, and dark blood, and piercing through the mattress of that bed, the blood was flowing down onto the floor as if some waterfall of water were running there, and lying on that bed was the mutilated body of the city's well-known businessman Alok Nath, on whose neck so many deep and successive blows had been inflicted with a sharp weapon that his head was on the verge of being separated from his torso, and his open eyes were staring toward the ceiling as if they still could not believe this terrible injustice and betrayal that such a horrifying incident had happened to him right inside his own home, while the red blood splashes were scattered across the walls of the room as if someone had played art by throwing splashes, and nearby on the floor lay a heavy iron blood-soaked rod and a scythe upon which stuck pieces of flesh and layers of blood bore testimony that the killer had left no stone unturned in executing this bloody game, whereas on the other side of the room in a corner the door of a wooden wardrobe stood open with all its clothes and necessary documents scattered across the floor, and red blood prints had also stamped those papers, indicating that the killer had not only come to spill blood but had also ransacked that room in search of some very huge valuable thing, and when Inspector Vikram Singh put on his gloves and stepped inside the room, the clotted blood beneath his shoes made squelching sounds, making the atmosphere of the entire room even more spine-chilling, while one panel of the room's window was open through which the cold night breeze was entering, and along with that wind, the slight rustling of the curtains felt as if some ghostly scream were wandering in a suppressed voice inside the room itself, prompting the police forensic team to immediately start their investigation and gather fingerprints and evidence from every nook and cranny of the room, but the surprising thing was that in the name of scattered evidence in the room, only blood marks and some incomplete printed footprints were being found which were heading toward the outer balcony, and the drainpipe had been used to descend from the balcony, so when Inspector Vikram decided to dive deep into this sensational incident, he first started questioning the remaining family members and servants of the house, because executing this murder so cleanly and without any external struggle was the work of someone who was completely familiar with every single inch of that mansion and who also knew at what time which member of the house stayed where, and Alok Nath's wife Sumitra Devi, who had gone out of the city to some relative's place that night, returned home in a frantic state upon hearing this news, and when she saw such a horrifying corpse of her husband in that blood-soaked room, she let out a roar and fainted, making it extremely difficult even for the female police personnel present there to handle her, and when Sumitra Devi regained consciousness, she told the police amidst crying and sobbing that her husband had no personal enmity or dispute with anyone, but for the past few days he had been quite troubled regarding his business partner and manager Sohan Lal because some heavy financial irregularities had been found in the company accounts, following which Alok Nath had given a strict warning to Sohan Lal and had even stated that if the accounts were not cleared, he would hand him over to the police, and as soon as this clue was received, Inspector Vikram Singh's suspicion turned directly toward Sohan Lal, and without wasting a single moment, he dispatched his teams to various locations across the city in search of Sohan Lal, while the police also discovered that on the night of the incident the lock of the back door of the mansion was open from the inside and the guard was missing from duty that night, who upon being searched was found lying unconscious in a corner of the mansion as someone had fed him a heavy dose of a narcotic substance, and as the needles of investigation moved forward, the mystery of this blood-soaked room deepened even more because when the police thoroughly reviewed the forensic report, it came to light that the weapon used in the murder was not just any ordinary weapon, but a special type of hunting knife and a heavy iron rod upon which marks of a specific company were embossed, and when those marks were investigated, it was revealed that such rods and knives are found only at select construction sites in the city, and coincidentally the contractor of that project was none other than Sohan Lal's close relative Ajay, prompting the police to act swiftly, apprehend both Ajay and Sohan Lal, and bring them to stand right inside that blood-soaked room so that they could be interrogated face-to-face, and when Sohan Lal and Ajay were brought to that horrifying place where the smell and terror of blood were still alive on the walls, the color of Sohan Lal's face drained and beads of sweat began to shine on his forehead, while Inspector Vikram Singh looked at both of them with his strict and piercing gaze and started firing questions one by one as to why they took the life of this human so ruthlessly just to hide multi-million embezzlement and what they were searching for sitting inside this blood-soaked room, and initially both of them tried their best to mislead the police and presented false proofs of their innocence claiming that they had gone far away from the city for some other work that night and had no remote connection with this murder, but police were not going to buy that easily, so when Inspector Vikram checked their phone call details and location of that night, the truth came out into the light, as technical evidence clearly proved that at the exact time of the incident, both Sohan Lal and Ajay were present right around this mansion of Alok Nath, and their location was being recorded right inside that blood-soaked room, besides which the police also obtained footage from an old CCTV camera installed outside the mansion in which two shadows were clearly seen jumping over the wall quietly at night and entering inside with their faces tied with cloth, holding the same weapons in their hands that were later recovered from that room, and when those concrete proofs were placed before those two beasts, all their arrogance was shattered to pieces in a split second, and Sohan Lal burst into tears, confessing to his crime and narrating the complete saga of that horrifying night before the police, telling in a trembling voice that he had been working in Alok Nath's company for the past several years and had withdrawn a heavy amount from the company funds due to his debauchery and gambling addiction, and when Alok Nath found out about this, he flatly refused to forgive him and threatened to go to the police, which made the ground slip from beneath Sohan Lal's feet out of fear, as the terror of losing his respect, job, and going to jail haunted him to such an extent that he hatched a horrifying conspiracy along with his relative Ajay to clear Alok Nath from his path forever, and according to the plan that night, they first fed the watchman a heavy amount of narcotic substance in a cold drink to render him unconscious and then quietly entered the mansion through the back door, reaching tiptoe straight to Alok Nath's bedroom where he was sleeping deeply, entering the room without making any sound, and before Alok Nath could open his eyes, Ajay struck a powerful blow on his head with an iron rod causing him to collapse unconsciously onto the bed, after which Sohan Lal, blinded by anger and revenge, struck multiple successive blows on his neck with that sharp weapon, turning the entire room into a bath of blood within minutes and causing him to die on the spot in excruciating pain, and after executing the incident, both of them fled away by the same route they came from, gathering some essential documents and cash kept in the wardrobe, thinking that they would succeed in hiding this blind murder and no one would ever find a clue to the killer, but they forgot that the arms of the law are very long and every single drop of blood bears testimony through its own voice, so the police arrested both Sohan Lal and Ajay and sealed that blood-soaked room to complete further legal proceedings, thus uncovering this gruesome murder mystery that shook the entire city to its core, and justice prevailed which must have brought some peace to that innocent soul, but that blood-soaked room still stands inside that mansion just like a black shadow, silently bearing witness to that terrifying night, and anyone who passes by from there still hears groaning and painful sighing sounds echoing from inside that room, becoming the most horrifying example of human greed and betrayal recorded forever in the pages of history.
content_hi: शहर के पॉश इलाके की पुरानी और सुनसान सी दिखने वाली कोठी नंबर बयालीस के भीतर जैसे ही पुलिस के कदम पड़े वैसे ही हवा में एक भारी सन्नाटा और खून की तेज दुर्गंध तैरने लगी थी जिसे महसूस कर वहां मौजूद हर एक सिपाही का दिल दहल उठा था और मुख्य दरवाजे से लेकर अंदर तक का रास्ता किसी भयानक तबाही की दास्तान कह रहा था क्योंकि जैसे ही इंस्पेक्टर विक्रम सिंह ने टॉर्च की रोशनी उस अंदरूनी कमरे की तरफ डाली तो उनकी आंखें फटी की फटी रह गई और मुंह से एक हल्की सी चीख निकल पड़ी जिसे उन्होंने तुरंत दबा लिया क्योंकि वह कमरा किसी कसाईखाने से भी बदतर हालत में बदल चुका था और उस कमरे का कोना कोना लाल रंग की खौफनाक चादर में लिपटा हुआ था जिसे देखकर साफ अंदाजा लगाया जा सकता था कि यहां मौत ने कितनी बेरहमी और तड़पा तड़पा कर तांडव मचाया होगा उस खून से सने कमरे के बीचों बीच एक चौड़ा पुराना पलंग रखा हुआ था जिस पर बिछी सफेद चादर अब पूरी तरह से गहरे गाढ़े और काले खून में तब्दील हो चुकी थी और उस पलंग के गद्दे को चीरकर खून नीचे फर्श पर ऐसे बह रहा था जैसे वहां कोई पानी का झरना चल रहा हो और उस बिस्तर पर शहर के जानेमाने व्यवसायी आलोक नाथ का क्षत विक्षत शरीर पड़ा हुआ था जिनकी गर्दन पर किसी धारदार हथियार से इतने गहरे और ताबड़तोड़ वार किए गए थे कि उनका सिर धड़ से अलग होने की कगार पर था और उनकी खुली हुई आंखें छत
